coverage_policy.note: Profiles are scenario families, not exhaustive representations of all locations, seasons, altitudes, event sequences, or unknown physics.

validation_rules: All scenario_id values are unique and stable.
Each profile declares a deployment_mode; gas/ice giants must not be silently treated as solid-surface habitats.
Every profile states required model domains and the evidence basis/limitations.
Missing environmental dimensions are unknown/not_evaluated, not numerically zero.
No probabilities are assigned to synthetic/adversarial stress cases without a defensible occurrence model.
A high-level body label never substitutes for site, season, altitude/depth, orbit, illumination or mission trajectory.
